text:
marina: Noticed a mismatch in the Chat streaming docs. The API ref shows a single JSON array `events` in the response example, but the runtime sends newline-delimited SSE chunks (each chunk is a JSON event). This confused a customer. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4999

connor: Ah yeah, that came from converting a recorded session into a static example. We should show an actual SSE example and a short note: "The streaming endpoint uses server-sent events; do not expect a single array payload."

amy: Agreed. Also the example event shape uses `author` but the SDK uses `role`. We need to standardize in docs. Backend emits `role` now. 

marina: Proposed changes: 1) replace the array example with an SSE transcript (newline-delimited JSON), 2) add a cURL + JS fetch streaming snippet, 3) add a migration note for `author` -> `role`.

connor: For the JS snippet, show both `fetch` with `response.body.getReader()` and the SDK streaming helper. Minimal fetch example:
```js
const res = await fetch('/v1/chat/stream', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'chat-1', messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'hi'}] }) });
const reader = res.body.getReader();
// read loop omitted for brevity
```
Make sure we show `role` not `author`.

amy: For Go examples, highlight that the generated OpenAPI client currently tries to unmarshal into a `[]Event` which fails on streaming. Recommend adding a short code note: use the streaming client or read line-by-line and unmarshal each JSON event. Example snippet suggestion:
```go
sc := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
for sc.Scan() {
  var ev Event
  json.Unmarshal(sc.Bytes(), &ev)
  // handle ev
}
```
Also mention `omitempty` caveat: empty fields may be omitted in the stream.

marina: Good catches. I'll update the docs PR with: actual SSE transcript example, clear "Streaming vs non-streaming" header, migration note for `author`->`role`, and language-tagged snippets for cURL/JS/Go/Python.

connor: Small nit: the OpenAPI examples generator should not output an array for streaming endpoints. Can you add a generator TODO? We should prefer a raw-event transcript for docs on streaming paths.

amy: I'll add a short Slack note to SDK owners to ensure their examples use `role` and that TS/Go examples don't serialize undefined fields as empty arrays for streaming requests.

docs-bot: PR #4999 opened by marina: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4999 — updates chat streaming docs, adds SSE examples and migration notes. CI: running.

marina: Thanks all. If CI passes, I'll merge after 1 more review. Ping this thread if you spot any downstream snippet mismatches after the merge.
